title: Handstand Technique Guide
description:
Perform your max hold time of handstand (without wall) until failure. Then complete the handstand hold progressions until failure starting with the hardest progression, and working your way to the easiest progression.

If you are unable to complete a specific day/step successfully, repeat the previous day/steps until you can progress successfully.

title: Pullover Technique Guide
description:

title: Full Planche Technique Guide
description:
Welcome to Full Planche Guide. These are the requirements of this guide:
1. Dips (15x)
2. Straight Bar Dips (15x)
3. Regular Push ups (25x)
4. L-sit Hold (15sec)
5. Wall Plank hold (20 sec)

Remember to keep perfect form and safety first! If you are unable to complete a specific day/step successfully, repeat the previous day/steps until you can progress successfully.
